sites.evidence_type: N-terminal HA epitope; parallel surface-display screen
sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface immunostaining PME 1872.4 ± 246.5 (HA immunostaining, Tedman deep receptor scanning)
sites.rationale: Experimentally validated N-terminal HA epitope insertion (after signal-peptide cleavage where present); surface expression read out by HA immunostaining in Tedman et al. deep receptor scanning.

sources.citation: Tedman et al., Efficient experimental characterization of the GPCRome via deep receptor scanning, Nat Commun 2026 (bioRxiv 2025.09.19.677468, PMC12458215)
sources.claim: N-terminal HA epitope inserted per receptor; surface expression read out by HA immunostaining in a pooled GPCRome deep-receptor-scanning screen.

literature_notes: All four ledger lines (L1–L4) describe C-terminal fluorescent-protein or luciferase tags (mApple, RLuc8, NanoBiT) fused to full-length GRPR. GRPR is a class A GPCR whose C-terminus (residues 325–384) is intracellular, lying after TM7 (302–324). A tag appended after residue 384 therefore faces the cytoplasm, not the extracellular space. No ledger line describes any insertion at the extracellular N-terminus (1–40), ECL1 (100–114), ECL2 (179–208), or ECL3 (287–301). Because the ledger contains zero evidence of a tolerated extracellular tag insertion on GRPR, no surface sites are proposed.

literature_other_positions.note: C-terminal mApple/RLuc8/NanoBiT tag appended after the last residue (V384) of the intracellular C-tail (325–384); surface-expressed and functional (GRP-stimulated endosomal trafficking, BRET beta-arrestin recruitment confirmed in L2–L4), but the tag faces the cytoplasm, not the extracellular space.
